steps.text: Leontuzzo forgot what happened that day.
He was still too young at the time.
He knows only two things for certain.
That day was not the day his mother died.
That day was the only time he ever saw his father look somewhat lost.
He walked through the rainy streets and saw his father sitting outside the church without an umbrella.
He tried to run over to hold up his umbrella for his father, but slipped and fell.
His father picked him up. The rain was heavier than usual that day. He could not clearly see his father's expression, but was still acutely aware of his father's chagrin.
He still remembers the question his father asked him at the time—
Would Siracusa be better off without the famiglie?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Leon, Leon!

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Wake up!

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Unngh...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Demetri...

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Why are you lying on the ground here? Where's the Don? Were you attacked?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: No... Father, he...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Right, my father! Where is he?!

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Nobody knows where the Don is... And just now, Rubio broke the news about our alliance with the Saluzzos over the radio.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: He also slandered us, accusing us of joining together against Signora Sicilia. Now, all the famiglie are looking right at us.
Would Siracusa be better off without the famiglie?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: That's not exactly slander, is it?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Leon?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I know what my father wants to do.

steps.name: Energetic Technician
steps.text: Who would've thought this Rubio guy...

steps.name: Calm Technician
steps.text: Was actually a complete idiot.

steps.name: Energetic Technician
steps.text: What are you talking about? He's clearly a good man!

steps.name: Calm Technician
steps.text: No, what I mean is what's the point of him even saying stuff like that?

steps.name: Calm Technician
steps.text: He finally managed to climb up to that position, and now he's gonna die over a few sentences.

steps.name: Calm Technician
steps.text: What a waste of a perfectly good life.

steps.name: Energetic Technician
steps.text: Are you crying?

steps.name: Calm Technician
steps.text: No. I'm not.

steps.name: Energetic Technician
steps.text: Want a tissue?

steps.name: Calm Technician
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Energetic Technician
steps.text: Who are you? Employees only.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: I am the boss of Famiglia Bellone. But you can just call me Bernardo.

steps.name: Energetic Technician
steps.text: Huh? The Don of Famiglia Bellone?!

steps.name: Calm Technician
steps.text: Wh-What brings an honored Dodici don here?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: If memory serves me properly, this place is supposed to split off and become the secondary command tower of the new nomadic city's core.

steps.name: Calm Technician
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Then, there's one thing I'd like to ask of you.

steps.name: Energetic Technician
steps.text: Wh-What are you doing?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Begin the separation sequence for the secondary core area.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: ...Impossible.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: But, that does explain everything.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: What my father told you, that we were planning to ignite an all-out war between all the famiglie to flush Signora Sicilia out, it was a feint.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: From the very beginning, Famiglia Bellone has just been a bargaining chip for him.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Everything you see now was his design.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Everything was for the sake of a Siracusa without famiglie.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You seriously expect me to believe that the don of the most powerful famiglia in the country... is trying to destroy all the famiglie?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: You have no choice but to believe, Demetri.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: You just said all the famiglie are looking at us, right?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Yes, but even if they believed Rubio, nobody would dare to do anything rash so soon.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: But, it's just a matter of time.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: The fuse has already been lit...
Would Siracusa be better off without the famiglie?
Padre mio, this is what you've believed all this time.
That's why you had Demetri test me in the first place.
But, what do you want me to do?
What can I even do?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Leon.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You said before that you'd handle things your way, Leon.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I did.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Then, you should focus up.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Whatever the situation, at this critical moment, the don is not here. You are now the boss of the famiglia.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: We have to do something.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Go and tell the Saluzzos that I want to meet with Alberto.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Then, get in touch with the Rossati man, Wallach.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You mean... I see.
What is it I hope to do?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: By building goodwill through Carracci's legacy, you got the people to believe that you really chose to draw all the fire purely out of a desire to avenge him.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: It wasn't until the end that you finally revealed a sliver of your real face.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Your self-control is admirable, Rubio.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Unfortunately, I knew a long time ago that you and Carracci were on the same path.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Neither of you were willing to accept the yoke of famiglie rule forever.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Only, he stepped onto the stage like a moth to a flame, while you concealed yourself a bit better.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: After all, I was in charge of the liquidation thirty years ago. I remembered him, and naturally, I remembered you as well.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: It came as a surprise to me that you chose to make your move now, but that brings with it opportunity.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Is the separation sequence still not complete?

steps.name: Calm Technician
steps.text: It'll be done shortly.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: I hope you know that stalling for time and playing petty tricks won't accomplish anything.

steps.name: Calm Technician
steps.text: The lives of all my colleagues are in your hands, I'm not kidding.

steps.name: Calm Technician
steps.text: I don't want anything to do with the conflicts between your big famiglie. I just hope you keep your promise.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: You say that, but the look in your eyes and the beating of your heart tells me that you're ready to die with me.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Relax. I just want to ask you a question.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Have you ever thought about what a Siracusa without famiglie would look like?
Danbrown stares blankly at the scene unfolding in front of his eyes.
He has slain many people and seen his fair share of corpses.
He became numb to the sight of blood a long time ago.
But this is something altogether different.

steps.name: Saluzzo Mafioso
steps.text: Danbrown, why are you still here?

steps.name: Saluzzo Mafioso
steps.text: The Don wants to meet the Bellone and Rossati bosses, so hurry up and do what you need to do!

steps.name: Danbrown
steps.text: What is the Don doing?

steps.name: Saluzzo Mafioso
steps.text: Are you deaf, Danbrown?

steps.name: Saluzzo Mafioso
steps.text: The Don is about to meet the Bellones, and told us to prepare.

steps.name: Danbrown
steps.text: Prepare what?

steps.name: Saluzzo Mafioso
steps.text: You don't get it?

steps.name: Saluzzo Mafioso
steps.text: The Don sincerely wanted to cooperate with the Bellones, and that broadcast just now was them trying to drag us underwater.

steps.name: Saluzzo Mafioso
steps.text: How could the Don let that go unpunished?

steps.name: Saluzzo Mafioso
steps.text: The Bellones were the first to sully our honor, so it's not our fault if we're a little discourteous with them.

steps.name: Saluzzo Mafioso
steps.text: The Don's meaning is obvious. Follow his orders at the meeting. Famiglia Bellone is about to be wiped from Siracusa.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Why are they chasing money and power instead of violence and conflict?

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Is killing me today just a cathartic release of this violence?

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Or is it because... I got in the way of the people behind you taking power?
Danbrown suddenly understands why he hasn't been able to sleep at night.
Texas knows why she has been hesitating.
She doesn't like to think, and that means when she encounters a situation in which she is forced to think, she plans everything to the letter in advance.
She anticipated this well before she ever set out on her trip to Siracusa.
She knew she would have to fight.
But, she believes that what she did in Lungmen was not fundamentally different from what she had done in Columbia or Siracusa.
She does not believe that her life in Lungmen is righteous, just as she does not believe that her life in Siracusa or Columbia was evil.
She has always dealt in the logistics of life and death.
She knew she would one day have to face the land of Siracusa.
But she had already made up her mind.
Just as she had once asked her grandfather this question:
'Isn't Siracusan morality just trampling on the lives of the people all the same?'
She even anticipated meeting up with old acquaintances like Giovanna.
She really did anticipate all of this.
And that's why she has been tossing and turning sleeplessly for several nights.
But the one thing she did not expect was that she would meet people here who wanted to change the place.
Leontuzzo—even though he is the heir to a famiglia, his way of thinking is progressive. His ideas may still be immature, but they are never violent.
Lavinia—a puppet of Signora Sicilia's will, but a judge who nevertheless wants the law to apply equally.
Carracci—even though she never met him, she learned from many sources that he served the people as Ministro dei Lavori Pubblici.
And finally—
She used to feel that there would never be an end to all this, that she was powerless to change Siracusa, that everything was too deeply entrenched.
So she chose to run.
However, after returning this time, she's met people who wanted to make this land a better place, and they were hurt, one after another.
Would she still choose to run?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: I found her! Cellinia's over here!
She has been hesitating because her desire to return to Lungmen is real.
But at the same time, her anger towards the plight of those people is just as real.
And right before her eyes, a good man with good intentions is forced by this country to cry out, at the cost of his life.
That is when Texas realizes—
Never in her life has she felt so outraged.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Woah, what's with the crowd?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Looks like some of them are starting to charge.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Don't blame me for this, Texas. I've already done what I could.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Why would I blame you?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Heya, partner, you get a good rest?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Good enough.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You look pretty mad.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: So you can tell.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Of course. Just like how you can guess what I wanna eat from my mood.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: We've been partners for so many years.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Exusiai, a good man just died.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I heard.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: There's something I want to do for him.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I was thinking the same thing.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Do my ears deceive me, Texas?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You're planning on staying, aren't you?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Lappland...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Thank you for 'doing your best' to help me get back to Lungmen.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: But I've already made up my mind.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: There are a few people out there who don't deserve to die like that. They need help. They deserve it.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Can you actually do anything about that?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Is this little fairy tale enough to make you choose a different path?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: This little fairy tale is more than enough to make me choose a different path.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Some things aren't that complicated at all, Lappland.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You, on the other hand...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: How long are you going to stay on a leash?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: What, are you lecturing me now?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Take it as a little advice from someone's who been there.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Exusiai, I'm going to break the encirclement. Back me up.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You got it!

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Texas, you're always full of surprises.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Aha... Haha, ahaha!
The sounds of footsteps and screams gradually dissipate with Texas and Exusiai's departure, and the alley falls silent again.
Only the hollow laughter of the lone white wolf continues to reverberate.
Until she too stops laughing.
She turns her gaze in a certain direction. Not the one Texas left, but rather where Famiglia Saluzzo resides.

steps.name: Rubio's Daughter
steps.text: Father... He.... Urk....

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Feel any better?

steps.name: Rubio's Daughter
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Rubio's Daughter
steps.text: Your Honor, why would my father do something like that?

steps.name: Rubio's Daughter
steps.text: I wish he would've kept doing what he did before... If only he'd just kept on being an ordinary segretario...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: You might not understand this yet, but your father was a great man.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I'll send people to keep you safe. Stay inside, and don't wander out. Alright?

steps.name: Rubio's Daughter
steps.text: I-I can feel it... After what my father has done, the whole city is going to turn upside-down.

steps.name: Rubio's Daughter
steps.text: You should hide here with me.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Thank you, but I have work to do.
Lavinia walks out of the room.
The peal of that gunshot resounds through Volsinii. Even the dark clouds part for a few minutes as if spooked, letting a few strands of sunlight filter through, for the first time in ages.
Her agreement with Bernardo was once her only goal.
To the point that when she found out Bernardo had broken his promise, she didn't know what to do with herself.
But now, she knows.
Because she's been told she does not stand alone.
And the ones who told her made a sacrifice a hundred times more heroic than her struggles.
Compared to them, she might actually be the lucky one.
But she does not plan to stand by and rely on this luck.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Ministro Rubio, your sacrifice will not be in vain.
She strokes the codex in her hands, a few names from Rubio's diary still lingering in her head.
She has either seen them before, or heard of them.
This is the most bountiful legacy that Rubio has left behind for her.
Moreover—

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Who is it?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Penguin Logistics. Need something delivered?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Don Alberto.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: I came because I heard Bellone wanted to speak with me.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: What, does Bernardo not even dare to show his face?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: My father made his own decision.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Just trust that I can speak on behalf of Famiglia Bellone.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: You mean to tell me that you have a satisfactory explanation for all this?

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Or, are you confident enough to deal with the fallout?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: What I wanted to say is——

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Danbrown, I didn't call for you to come out yet.

steps.name: Danbrown
steps.text: No, the time is now, old man.
Danbrown points the weapon in his hand at Alberto.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Danbrown, I'm afraid you're pointing your knife at the wrong target.

steps.name: Danbrown
steps.text: I don't make mistakes.

steps.name: Danbrown
steps.text: Look what the famiglie bosses have become.

steps.name: Danbrown
steps.text: You all sit high-and-mighty above the rest of us, talking all fancy about your politics, trends, country, and future.

steps.name: Danbrown
steps.text: But what's the reality? The only thing you give a damn about is your own business.

steps.name: Danbrown
steps.text: We took the times with violence, old man.

steps.name: Danbrown
steps.text: Why not take a little pride in it?

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: The times have changed, Danbrown. Why don't you understand this?

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: We're shaping the times as we want.

steps.name: Danbrown
steps.text: I don't understand it. I just see us turning weak and stupid.

steps.name: Danbrown
steps.text: We don't take pride in our instincts, and we don't use peace to fight for peace.

steps.name: Danbrown
steps.text: If we keep this up, what will we become?

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: We won't become anything.

steps.name: Danbrown
steps.text: No, we're not a pack of wolves anymore.

steps.name: Danbrown
steps.text: We're monsters hiding in human skin.

steps.name: Danbrown
steps.text: And, our leaders.

steps.name: Danbrown
steps.text: You.

steps.name: Danbrown
steps.text: And you.

steps.name: Danbrown
steps.text: You aren't more civilized. You're just more hypocritical.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Looks like I should've kept you on a tighter leash, Danbrown.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: This isn't your podium.
Nobody could've caught what happens next.
In the blink of an eye, Alberto appears behind Danbrown.
A streak of blood appears across the carwash worker's throat.
He grips his neck, his eyes wide, unable to make a sound.
Then, he slowly slumps to the ground, maintaining this posture.
He will never speak again.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Now that this matter is resolved, I won't beat around the bush, Leontuzzo.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Your father convinced me to agree to combine our famiglie's forces to take down Signora Sicilia.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: But I don't see sincerity in anything you've done.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: The people know that I, Don Alberto, never place a bet lightly. What they don't know is that once I do, I never stop until I win.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Leontuzzo.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Submit to Famiglia Saluzzo, or die, here and now.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: You have ten seconds.
Alberto takes out an antiquated pocket watch from his waist and begins counting down Leontuzzo's fate.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: You've always got the option of violence, but you refrain from using it because of your upbringing and self-control. I'd even like to thank you for your kindness.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: That's not what I meant.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: And I'm not blaming you either, Leon.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: For you to even consider why the rain hasn't stopped is already exceptionally rare to see.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: You've subconsciously lumped yourself in with Lavinia and Carracci.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: But don't ever forget, you are not one of them.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: If you really knew, you wouldn't be standing here.
Leontuzzo thought he understood what they were trying to say.
He could never truly be Lavinia's ally. He would always be his father's son.
This is the life he was born into, something he cannot change. And in spite of that, he's always believed he has done his best.
Is his best not good enough?
But—

steps.name: Danbrown
steps.text: You aren't more civilized. You're just more hypocritical.
This is the moment when he finally awakens.
It isn't a question of good enough. He has been wrong from the very beginning.
We aren't more civilized. We're just more hypocritical.
We aren't more civilized. We're just more hypocritical!
Right. That's right.
Why is he sitting here?
Why did he still think he could resolve this like the famiglie do?
He knew the answer all along.
But he chose to ignore this answer for the longest time because of who he is and where he came from.
Everything he's done before was just violence wrapped up in pretense.
And civility... can never be born from violence.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: You're running short on time, Leontuzzo.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I choose...

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: What just happened?!

steps.name: Saluzzo Mafioso
steps.text: Boss! The secondary core area! Someone started the separation program!

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: What did you say?!

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: So this is your last resort, father.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Then, I'll——

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Too naive.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Hmph, you're pretty fast for your age.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: A Rossati?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Leon, I'm here.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You go on ahead. I'll handle this.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: I see, so this is Bellone's trump card...

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: But, are you sure you really want to make an enemy of me, Don Alberto, and of the Saluzzos?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You expect me to believe you were ever really going to be our friend?

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Shared interest could've been the bond connecting us, pup.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: But, there's something to your youthful delusions, thinking you can actually turn things upside-down.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: You old fossils always think you can control everything, but you never stop to consider whether the times have left you behind.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Come then, pups. Let me try your hand.
Leontuzzo knows that as the don of a famiglia, he should return home and navigate his people through these turbulent times to maximize their profit.
But as a man who thinks he understands Lavinia's ideals, a man who saw the way Carracci conducted himself, as a man who has always been lost...
He's never been clearer about what he should do next.
He can't lie to himself anymore.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I'm sorry, Demetri.
He does not walk the path of his famiglia.
He knows where his father is.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: I did what I had to do.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: It won't be long before it reaches Zaaro.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: The time has come.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Agnese's Fang, Lunacub.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: You've kept me waiting.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: You're never alone, and I'm not good at taking a lot of opponents at once.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: I don't make a wise target.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Agnese told me that of the remaining Fangs, you are the one who most deserves to die.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: You've toyed around with the thing called 'power,' trying to use that garbage to win this.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Quite the profound insight from la Signora dei Lupi.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Do you know where the remaining Fangs are?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: One now lives at a company called Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: She returned to Siracusa not too long ago.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Another, knowing that there was no hope of victory, went into hiding and cultivated a student early.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: These two wandering wolves have now returned to Siracusa.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Another is still hiding in the wastes.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: And as long as I remain here, I can track their movements.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: With a little more power, I could exercise my will to find them, and have my men eliminate them.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: This is what Zaaro discovered — the might of power.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Does that count as victory?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: It's what he believes.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: How strange.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: The strange one is you, Fang of Agnese. You didn't come here to kill me, did you?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: I was just a little curious.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: You don't seem like an evil man, or one who wields power as you claimed.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: What do you see when you look at me, then?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: A beast who went looking for a place to die, now laying peacefully in it.

steps.name: Terrified Waiter
steps.text: Are those wise guys gone yet?

steps.name: Fearful Waiter
steps.text: They're gone, right?

steps.name: Terrified Waiter
steps.text: Thank goodness, I thought they were going to start fighting.

steps.name: Fearful Waiter
steps.text: But... what are we going to do with this body?

steps.name: Terrified Waiter
steps.text: I... I don't want to touch it.

steps.name: Fearful Waiter
steps.text: Still, I can't help but feel a bit bad for this guy.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: I'll handle it.

steps.name: Fearful Waiter
steps.text: Wh-Who are you?

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: Just a friend of this nameless man.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: You've discovered something important, my friend.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: Violence is done in the name of civility.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: That is the true nature of the famiglie.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: And we must come to terms—

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: With what we call civility, even if it's another pretense, even if it's just a form of self-restraint...

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: Even if it's only a stone's throw from our basest instincts...

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: An earnest desire for civility will always be different from using it to whitewash your sins.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: Neither this country nor this city will remember you.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: But I will remember you, Danbrown, the carwash worker.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: Together with Rubio, the two of you have proven the lie that famiglie can change and adapt.
